definition: The source status is the counterexample/obstruction status attached to the normal witness before quotienting.
source_condition: W is normal and has finite support S
caveat: Classification only; not a theorem about arbitrary status semantics.

definition: The contracted status is the status evaluated on W_contract=normalize(pushforward(W,q)).
source_condition: accepted equivalence classes and quotient map q:S->S/~ are defined
proof_requirement: normal-form and status evaluation must be defined
caveat: Normal-form preservation remains proof-sketch for arbitrary quotient witnesses.

definition: Status preservation depends on accepted coordinate equivalence being a congruence for all status-relevant fields.
source_condition: nontrivial class C is accepted equivalent
caveat: This is the central open status hypothesis.

definition: All coordinates in one accepted class are represented by one quotient coordinate.
source_condition: class C has size greater than one
caveat: The quotient is well-defined under preconditions, but status merge validity is not complete.

source_condition: status certificate is invariant under replacing C by [C]
proof_requirement: equivalent-coordinate status congruence plus normal-form preservation

definition: Contraction creates a smaller counterexample/status witness.
source_condition: nontrivial class exists and contracted status is valid counterexample or reduced obstruction
contracted_condition: W_contract is smaller under support measure
proof_requirement: measure decrease plus valid reduced-status theorem
caveat: Measure decrease is proved; status transfer/reduction remains open.

definition: Contraction destroys status without proving reduced/refuted branch.
source_condition: status fields are not congruent across the class
caveat: Failure is named, not hidden as success.

definition: After operation proof closure, unresolved support>8 residual can become deferred higher-support escape.
proof_requirement: higher-support bound after operation proofs close

definition: A nontrivial equivalence class strictly decreases support_size.
source_condition: C has size greater than one
caveat: Measure decrease does not imply status preservation.

definition: Payload fields must be mergeable along q.
source_condition: payload roles agree inside every class
caveat: Layerwise payload proof remains sketch outside accepted contract.

definition: Canonical roles must commute with quotient and normalization.
source_condition: canonical roles are compatible inside every class

definition: Recognized family-chain source form must remain recognized or route to a named blocker.
contracted_condition: W_contract remains recognized or named blocker

definition: Failure after operation proof closure can become deferred higher-support escape.
source_condition: all operation-specific proof routes close or fail
